reviews.text: There were issues such as being an hour late, not performing the treatments included in the course, and not removing matted fur despite being charged for it. Since things like ear cleaning and anal gland expression are health-related, I will not be using their services again.

I bring my two Toy Poodles in for a shampoo and haircut. They always listen carefully to my requests, but I leave it up to them. I'm very happy with the stylish haircuts that match the atmosphere of the very fashionable shop. The location is also great, close to Mejiro Station, so I would like to continue using their services. The groomer is also very beautiful and gentle with pets, so I can leave my dogs in their care with peace of mind.

I feel like the quality of the photos has dropped recently.
I was looking forward to having cute pictures taken, but I'm happy with the cut and everything else.

My dog ​​is elderly, but they handle things at a comfortable pace, so I feel at ease entrusting him to them.

They are also very helpful with scheduling and other arrangements.

I've been using Reri's services since moving, and I'm always thrilled that my dog ​​comes back looking even cuter than I hoped! They are very attentive and accommodating to even the smallest requests, so it's definitely best to clearly communicate your vision verbally. The sheet they provide afterward is also very helpful as it gives me a detailed understanding of my dog's condition.

This was my third visit!
All three times I've had a shampoo and a partial trim 🫧
The staff are always warm and kind, and I feel completely at ease leaving my hair in their care 😊
I always look forward to the post-shampoo photos they take as a complimentary service!
Thank you for giving my child such a cute haircut! 🐩 …

The finished result is truly beautiful, and I'm always so satisfied that I think, "My pet is so cute!" every time ✂️💕
Not only do they do exactly what I request, but they also give me professional advice, so I feel very confident leaving my pet in their care.
I look forward to continuing to work with you in the future 🩵

The consultation is very thorough and the cut is excellent. I always look forward to the photos they take after trimming! I have two dogs at the same time, so I would be very happy if they could take photos of us both side by side.

The haircut technique is excellent and the hair is always very cute. The staff are also kind and let you relax in the salon until you are picked up, creating a great atmosphere. I look forward to working with you again.
I always get a cute haircut here. The work is done carefully, and I'm very satisfied. They also have a photo booth where they take cute pictures.

I had been going there since it first opened.

However, various dissatisfactions piled up and I stopped going.

I previously saw several comments on this review site from people with similar complaints, but in their replies, they claimed they were not at fault, treated the customers as malicious complainers, and even revealed the names of their pets.

(These comments have now been deleted.)

I had a similar experience with the complaints, so I don't think I was a malicious complainer.

I had no particular complaints about the technical skills, but looking at the service as a whole, there were many aspects that I was not satisfied with.

Thank you for your continued support!

The staff are incredibly polite, and every time I come back with my dog ​​looking fluffy and adorable, like a stuffed animal!

What's more, the shop's atmosphere changes every month, and they even send me photos and data of my dog, so it's a truly wonderful shop with absolutely no downsides!
I always ask them to do my hair because they're so kind and their cuts are excellent! …

This was my second time having my dog ​​groomed here!😆 They always do such a lovely job, and the groomers are so kind; I feel completely at ease leaving my dog ​​in their care. Thank you so much for taking such wonderful photos!😆 I'll definitely be back!😆 …
